record.paper_title: Gradings, Braidings, Representations, Paraparticles: Some Open Problems
record.context_brief: Finite-group gradings of mixed paraparticle algebras
record.original_question: Over the complex numbers, classify all gradings of the paraparticle algebras and coalgebras called the Relative Parabose Set P_BF and the Relative Parafermi Set P_FB by small finite abelian groups. Equivalently, determine all group actions or coactions, or actions/coactions of the group Hopf algebra C G, that preserve the algebra and coalgebra structures so that these objects become C G-module or C G-comodule algebras and coalgebras.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work over the field $\mathbb{C}$ of complex numbers. Fix a positive integer and consider the mixed paraparticle algebra known as the Relative Parabose Set $P_{BF}$: it is the unital associative $\mathbb{C}$-algebra generated by parabosonic generators $b_i^\pm$ and parafermionic generators $f_j^\pm$ subject to the trilinear relative (anti)commutation relations of Greenberg–Messiah type, namely

$[\{b_i^\xi, b_j^\eta\}, b_k^\epsilon] = (\epsilon-\eta)\delta_{jk} b_i^\xi - (\epsilon-\xi)\delta_{ik} b_j^\eta$, 
$[[f_i^\xi, f_j^\eta], f_k^\epsilon] = |\epsilon-\eta|\delta_{jk} f_i^\xi \operatorname{sgn}(\epsilon) - |\epsilon-\xi|\delta_{ik} f_j^\eta \operatorname{sgn}(\epsilon)$ (with appropriate signs), together with the relative mixed relations
$[\{b_i^\xi, b_j^\eta\}, f_k^\epsilon] = 0$, $[\{b_i^\xi, f_j^\eta\}, b_k^\epsilon] = 0$, $\{[f_i^\xi, f_j^\eta], b_k^\epsilon\} = 0$, $\{[f_i^\xi, b_j^\eta], f_k^\epsilon\} = 2\delta_{jk}[f_i^\xi, b_l^\eta]\cdots$, etc., that define the Relative Parabose Set. The algebra $P_{BF}$ carries a natural Hopf-algebra-like coalgebra structure (a super-Hopf or graded comultiplication) making it a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-graded coalgebra. Define analogously the Relative Parafermi Set $P_{FB}$, with the roles of parabosons and parafermions exchanged.

Problem. Classify all gradings of the algebras and coalgebras $P_{BF}$ and $P_{FB}$ by small finite abelian groups $G$. Equivalently, determine, up to equivalence, all $\mathbb{C}G$-module algebra/coalgebra structures and all $\mathbb{C}G$-comodule algebra/coalgebra structures on $P_{BF}$ and $P_{FB}$; that is, classify all group actions and coactions of the group Hopf algebra $\mathbb{C}G$ that simultaneously preserve the algebra structure and the coalgebra structure.
artifact.status_search_result: A $(\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2)$-grading of the Relative Parabose Set algebra has been explicitly constructed, but a general classification of all gradings by finite abelian groups (and equivalently of all $\mathbb{C}G$-(co)module algebra/coalgebra structures) on $P_{BF}$ and $P_{FB}$ has not been found in the literature, indicating the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Ladder operators, Fock-spaces, irreducibility and group gradings for the Relative Parabose Set algebra
status_evidence.snippet: Finite abelian group gradings, specifically (Z_2 x Z_2)-gradings, are introduced for the algebra P^(1,1)_{BF} and the Fock-spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Only a specific (Z_2 x Z_2)-grading has been constructed; general classification not addressed.
